limitations: Counter deltas span warmup-end capture through final quiescence; maxima and P95 upper bounds cover the whole run.
Measurements use assumed diverse short-period input mixtures, not captured production traffic. Real history is preloaded before Pine startup; it is not historic Pine trading.
Prefilter runs outside the room writer lane, after task admission and committed-state matching. It does not remove all polling, scheduling or comparisons.

Fixed immutable-wave comparison measures host preparation/hash work only. Its 1000 account IDs have no funded account records; it is not a private-account or asynchronous capacity test. Asynchronous runs have differing market trajectories and cannot be reduced to a deterministic end-to-end speedup.
performance_evidence_accepted means the compiler/peer-server controls passed, not that capacity or trading SLOs passed. See the individual qualified fields.
Working set is summed per live process and counts shared pages repeatedly; short runs do not establish memory growth or leak behavior.

fixed_work.scope: 5000 idle host checks per mode, 1000 accounts, 384 real-content closed bars; immutable wave; excludes runtime, queue, copies of persisted state and commit
